label: HA Stock App Notifications
info:
Listens for ha_stock_app_* events from the HA Stock App integration and
sends formatted notifications to notify.mobile_app_owner.

Formatting reproduces the original node-red-portfolio-flow-v2 engine.
The integration now does the polling, market-hours gating, holiday
calendar and threshold logic, so this flow only formats and delivers.

Setup: change the action on the 'Mobile Notify' node if your device is
not notify.mobile_app_owner. Test it with the integration's own
'Send Test Notification' button after picking a type from the
'Test Notification Type' dropdown.
